prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Create exactly one 1024 x 1024 transparent PNG texture-source painting, paint_back.png.
Input image 1, guide_back.png, is the EDIT TARGET and sole authority for silhouette, geometry, orthographic back-view camera, size and placement. Input image 2, design_reference.png, is only the approved material and colour reference. Input image 3, concept_crop.png, is supporting original design reference.
Paint directly over the grey surfaces of image 1. Preserve its silhouette EXACTLY at the pixel level, including all edges, spikes, openings, scaffold pieces, banner, rubble and small details. Preserve the existing alpha outline and every hole. Do not rotate toward the reference view or add front-view features. Nothing added outside the silhouette, nothing cropped, no reframing or rescaling. Retain the back-view banner on the left, every tower fin and the rubble footprint exactly where the guide has them.
Apply the reference materials: chipped white ceramic with aged gold bands on the tower; black-violet resin and chitin with painted bright orange veins and sacs on the thorny organic structures; rust on the scaffold; dark black-glass rubble; aged red fabric on the existing banner. Transfer material appearance only, never reference geometry.
LIGHTING: this is ALBEDO for texture projection, not a beauty render. Even flat shadowless illumination from the viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion darkening, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. Orange glowing sacs and seams have their bright orange local colour only and cast NO light onto adjacent surfaces. Show material colour and fine wear without directional lighting.
Genuinely transparent background, no backdrop, no floor, no text or labels. Output exactly 1024 x 1024, same canvas and object placement as the guide.
reason: First return: requested material palette and back view, but native 1254x1254 instead of 1024x1024, silhouette/detail deviations and visible shading/highlights. Triggered the one permitted correction.

checks.flat_even_light: Not fully met: visible shading and highlights
